title: Record form: a row-conditioned field lock (`when`) disables the field on every row, though the write gate admits it on rows the condition does not name
body:
Ruled: 6457467702 · letter B · 2026-10-28T00:42Z

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect against a declared limitation, measured on @objectstack 18.2.0 (hotclm `main`, README-made personas, zh-CN console).

**Symptom.** hotclm's `clm_finance` locks the contract's legal fields and `status` only from `approved` onward, through a field permission `when` (#25866, shipped in 18.2.0; hotclm PR #166). A finance controller can therefore fill those fields on the draft they launch.
- The write gate agrees. The launch wizard writes them, and `PATCH clm_contract` with 摘要 / 适用法律 / 保密期限 / 管辖 on Finance Controller 1's own draft answers 200.
- The console disagrees. On that same draft, the record page's 编辑 dialog shows exactly those fields **disabled**.
- For the records manager (`clm_records`, locked from `signing` onward), every field but 档案号 is disabled on their own draft.

The user is told they cannot edit what they are allowed to edit.

**Why.** The 18.2.0 `FieldPermissionSchema.when` description says the readers that hold no row (the record form's field projection, `/auth/me/permissions`) report a conditioned entry as its lock on every row. The limitation is declared; this card asks to lift it for the record form, which does hold the row.

**Expected.** The record form's field projection judges `when` against the record being edited (the stored row, as the write gate does), so a conditioned lock disables a field only on rows it names. `/auth/me/permissions`, which has no row, may keep reporting the lock.

**Evidence.** hotclm os-dev-report https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm/issues/127#issuecomment-6438278260 and PR #166's Acceptance notes:
- `fc1` own draft: the 编辑 dialog disables the legal fields and 状态, while saving 标题 answers 200 and a PATCH of the legal fields answers 200;
- `rm1` own draft: only 档案号 is enabled.

**Business reason.** The point of a row-conditioned lock is "locked from this stage on". Every app that uses it, such as hotclm finance and records or a CRM's "lock the price after approval", shows the lock on rows where it does not apply.

**Consumer.** objectstack-ai/hotclm #127 (closed by PR #166; this is the residual).

**Duplicate search.** objectstack issues, all states: "form field projection when", "row-conditioned field permission form disabled", "row-blind field readers". Related, closed: #25866 (the `when` itself) and #26178 (docs recipe). No duplicate.
